'''2022 Match Play Championship''' was the Players Committee match-play championship on GEMP, 21–23 January 2022. [[Drew Lichtenstein]] finished 1st in the published Top 8.<ref name="pc">https://www.starwarsccg.org/2022-match-play-championship/</ref>
